IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Ways & Means (originally sponsored by Senators Rockefeller and Ranker)

Bill.BriefDescription: Suspending the powers and duties of the oil spill advisory council for the 20092011 biennium.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to oil spill advisory council; creating a newsection; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: During the 20092011 biennium, the powersand duties of the oil spill advisory council established in RCW90.56.120 are suspended.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJune 30, 2009.
